name: Captions burn
oneLiner: a glass caption track: the waveform plays under a sweeping playhead while word-by-word captions pop in sync with a pill sliding under each spoken word, then one word slams in huge with a ring and the wave spikes
say: when the speaker talks about captions, subtitles or one word that matters ('add captions and people watch twice as long', 'every word on screen'): the captions run in sync with them, the big word lands as they stress it
